description: Bridge v1.6: approximate alias. card_tags lacks distinct BOARDWIPE_CREATURES primitive; TARGETED_REMOVAL_CREATURE captures most board-wipe effects in the production tag pack. Calibration-coarse — false-positive risk on single-target removal.
